attributes.name: ypy-live
attributes.description: Runs a JavaScript expression when the element is processed and again whenever the DOM, an input or a swap may have changed what it reads. The expression runs with the `ypy-live` scope: `q()`, `take()`, `toggle()`, `trigger()`, `debounce()`, `forEvent()`, `nextFrame()`, `insert()`, `attr`, `data`, `aria`, `local` and `closest`. It needs `config.callbacks` to allow code.

attributes.name: ypy-live:*
attributes.description: Binds a JavaScript expression to a property of the element, re-evaluated like `ypy-live`. The name after the colon is an attribute or property (`value`, `disabled`, `aria-label`, `data-x`), `text` (textContent), `html` (innerHTML), `style`, `class` (object or string), `.name` (one class) or `?name` (a boolean attribute). The short form `:name` works when `config.live.bindPrefix` is `:` (the default).

config.name: live.inputDebounce
config.description: Debounces `input` events before expressions are re-evaluated, in ms or as an interval string.

config.name: live.bindPrefix
config.description: Short binding prefix: `":"` makes `:text` work, `"ypy:"` makes `ypy:text` work, and `""` or `false` turns the short form off. When Alpine.js is detected the short form is off unless this is set.

config.name: live.useDollar
config.description: Adds `$()` as an alias of `q()` in `ypy-live`, `:attr`, `ypy-on`, `js:` attributes and `ypy-trigger` filters.
